name: Microsoft for Education Daily
tldr: Microsoft 365 is back after the outage, fake outage notices are doing the rounds, and teachers get Minecraft and AI workshop news from Spain and Italy.
window: Window: the week's best, from the 80 hours to 05:00 AEDT, Sun 15 Nov 2026 (Wednesday 11 to Saturday 14 Nov in the US), plus This-week items.
notes: This week: Valencia's Minecraft Education Challenge (announced 11 Nov; entries 9-22 Nov, Valencian schools only) and Rome's Elevate for Educators Day (17 Nov; free, limited places). The week's other education news (Microsoft Classroom, Speaker Coach, Learning Zone's Minecraft lessons) was covered 12-13 Nov.

Teams' impersonation warnings are rolling out (roadmap 573157); Facilitator's question help is in development, due February 2027 (558341); Power Platform's hourly alerts reach public preview by 20 Nov; Gemini 4 Hydrogen is rolling out gradually to Copilot Pro and up. The fake-notice details are Microsoft Threat Intelligence's, as reported by iTnews.
Screenshots are the publishers' public pages as captured on 15 Nov 2026; copyright remains with the publishers.

post.text:

stories.title: Microsoft 365 is fully restored after this week's outage
stories.summary: Microsoft says Outlook, Teams and Copilot are fully restored: it has 'completed our efforts to address the underlying issue of the incident and restored service to the remaining impacted customers and regions'. A post-incident report is still to come.

stories.title: Watch for fake Microsoft 365 outage notices
stories.summary: Microsoft Threat Intelligence saw emails posing as Microsoft 365 service health notices that claim mail held during the outage will be deleted within 24 hours unless you click, with subject lines like 'Outage - [code]', as reported by iTnews.

stories.title: Valencia's Minecraft Education Challenge adds a special education category
stories.summary: The Valencian Community's third Minecraft Education Challenge has student teams, tutored by a teacher, build curricular worlds in seven categories, now including special education. Secondary, basic vocational and special education schools in the region can apply until 22 November.

stories.title: Elevate for Educators Day in Rome: free hands-on AI workshops for teachers
stories.summary: On Tuesday 17 November at Microsoft House in Rome, Microsoft and ANP host a morning for principals and three free afternoon workshops for teachers: Minecraft Education and the Hour of AI, safe AI and spotting deepfakes, and AI tools that include every student. Places are limited.

stories.title: Teams meetings now flag possible impersonators
stories.summary: Impersonation Protection for Teams meetings surfaces warnings and risk indicators when Teams detects a potential impersonation attempt by a participant or organizer. Handy for an online class or a parent evening (our example).
stories.for: Teachers and staff who meet online

stories.title: Teams' Facilitator is due to help with questions nobody answers in meetings
stories.summary: When someone asks a question in a Teams meeting and no one answers, Facilitator is due to offer to find an answer with web search; participants choose 'Yes' to get it.

stories.title: Out-of-band updates fix November's KMS activation bug
stories.summary: Out-of-band updates such as KB5136483 fix slmgr.vbs licensing and activation commands failing with error 0x80041008 after November's updates. It mainly hit organisations scripting KMS activation; already-activated PCs stayed activated.

stories.title: The GitHub Copilot app now works with GitHub Enterprise Server
stories.summary: Add a GitHub Enterprise Server account to the GitHub Copilot app (version 1.2.0 and later) to work with remote repositories, issues and pull requests. Cloud sessions aren't available for GHES.

stories.title: Gemini 4 Hydrogen arrives in GitHub Copilot
stories.summary: Google's latest Flash model, built for fast agentic coding and tool use, is generally available in GitHub Copilot for Pro, Pro+, Max, Business and Enterprise users, rolling out gradually in VS Code, Visual Studio, the CLI and more.

stories.title: Power Platform alerts can check critical flows, apps and agents every hour
stories.summary: Monitor's new hourly alert rules check chosen health metrics every hour instead of every day, for Copilot Managed Runtime apps and supported Power Platform resources. It reaches public preview in all commercial clouds by 20 November.

stories.title: Microsoft's AI-assisted Linux bug hunt: 59 reports from over 26,000 findings
stories.summary: In Microsoft's FORGE Lab, one researcher and one intern used AI to scan Linux kernel subsystems: 26,502 raw findings became 59 upstream reports and 33 CVEs, after months of expert checking with Linux maintainers.

stories.title: GitHub Copilot retires six models on 14 December
stories.summary: Claude Fable 5, Claude Haiku 4.5, Gemini 3.8 Flash, Gemini 4 Argon, Grok 4.6 and Kimi K3 leave all Copilot experiences; move workflows to the suggested alternatives, such as Gemini 4 Hydrogen. Haiku 4.5 stays for individual subscribers on annual plans.

stories.title: Attackers abused ScreenConnect to spread the SCKit worm, Microsoft says
stories.summary: Microsoft Threat Intelligence confirmed attacks on managed service providers' cloud-hosted ScreenConnect instances that installed unauthorised remote-access clients and SCKit, which targets technicians' PCs. If your school's IT support uses ScreenConnect, check technician PCs and managed devices.

stories.title: Candy Crush Saga celebrates Xbox's 25th with a Game On! Season
stories.summary: For four weeks, Candy Crush Saga has collectible pins from Halo, Fallout, Sea of Thieves, Forza, DOOM, Banjo-Kazooie, Crash and Spyro, plus six game themes reworked with an orchestra, the Bulgarian Voices Berlin choir and an accordion.

stories.title: Ranger's Path: National Park Simulator comes to Xbox on 17 November
stories.summary: Restore trails, assist visitors and document wildlife as a park ranger in Faremont National Park; it's an Xbox Play Anywhere game, and release dates are subject to change.

transcript.t: Welcome to the Microsoft for Education Daily, Sunday edition.
Here's what shipped at Microsoft in the last 24 hours.
Back to class. Microsoft says Outlook, Teams and Copilot are fully restored after this week's outage.
And watch for fake outage emails saying your held mail will be deleted.
In Spain, Valencia's Minecraft Education challenge now has a category for special education schools.
In Rome on Tuesday, Microsoft's Elevate for Educators Day runs free, hands-on AI workshops for teachers.
Teaching online?
Teams is rolling out warnings that flag possible impersonators in your meetings.
From February, Teams' Facilitator should spot unanswered questions and offer to look them up.
For school IT, an out-of-band update fixes November's bug that broke KMS activation commands.
University dev teams on GitHub Enterprise Server ca n now bring their repos into the GitHub Copilot app.
Coding with Copilot?
Google's Gemini 4 Hydrogen is rolling out, for Pro plans and up.
Campus app makers get hourly alerts for critical flows, apps and agents, in preview by November 20.
In the lab, a Microsoft researcher and an intern used AI to hunt for Linux bugs.
Over 26,000 raw findings became 59 bug reports, after months of expert checking.
On December 14, GitHub Copilot retires six models, like Gemini 3.8 Flash.
And if your school's IT support uses ScreenConnect, Microsoft says attackers abused it to spread malware.
After hours, Candy Crush celebrates Xbox's 25th with Halo, Fallout and Forza pins, for four weeks.
Six game themes got the Candy Crush treatment, with an orchestra, a choir and, yes, an accordion.
And from Tuesday, Ranger's Path lets you restore trails and document wildlife in a national park.
Services restored, fakes spotted, fixes in: Monday's sorted. Back to class.
Every day, the changelog gets a little longer.
On the release board: shipped, and still shipping.
That was 24 hours at Microsoft. Tomorrow, there's more.
That's the Microsoft for Education Daily for today.
Stay curious. See you tomorrow.
